comment: Cache resident vs streaming read with the same work (same logical_mib), sized for about 60 s of streaming on a GN100 (streaming 240 GB/s, resident 1,161 GB/s, so the resident slot finishes sooner; compare energy per byte). Idle between slots so windows never overlap; the sham (empty calls, no data) is the reference for the cost of the GPU being kept busy. Size logical_mib for your machine from probe_rates.json.
